{{recipe}} 

Shortribs cooked in beef broth with aromatic herbs and vegetables makes a fork-tender, flavorful entrée.

== Ingredients ==
* 2 ½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] (1.35 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]]) English cut [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] shortribs
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]] fat
* 6 cups beef [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
* 1 ½ cups [[Cookbook:Red Wine|red wine]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Tomato Paste|tomato paste]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] dried [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] dried [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]
* Finely-chopped rosemary
* 1 large [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 3 Tbsp minced [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], peeled and cut into 1-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (2.5 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) slices
* 3 red-skinned [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], cut into 2-inch (5 cm) cubes
* 1 Tbsp [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* Flour

== Procedure ==
#Heat bacon fat in a 6-quart (6-liter) cast iron [[Cookbook:Dutch Oven|Dutch oven]] over medium-high heat. Season shortribs with salt, freshly ground black pepper, then dredge in flour. Place 1 or 2 in the pot at one time, and cook until browned on all sides. Repeat until all shortribs have been browned. Keep warm.
#If there is not enough fat in the pan to coat the bottom, add olive oil. Add ¼ of the vegetables at a time and sauté until browned around the edges. Repeat until all vegetables have been sautéed.
#Add remaining ingredients and browned shortribs. Place into a cold [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] and then set for 250°F (120°C). Cook 5 ½ hours.
#Move to serving bowls and sprinkle each serving with finely chopped rosemary. Serve warm.
